notifications.label: Notifications
notifications.deviceLabelHint: Tells your devices apart, for example “Phone”.
notifications.enabled: Enabled on this device. Reminders arrive even when the app is closed.
notifications.iosInstall: On iPhone and iPad, notifications work only from the installed app (iOS 16.4 or later). Install it first.
notifications.blocked: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in the browser settings, then come back here.
notifications.serverOff: Notifications are not set up on this server.
notifications.needsGesture: Tap the switch again to allow notifications.

reminders.label: Reminders
reminders.hint: For your account, on every device where notifications are on.
reminders.quietHint: Reminders that fall inside wait until the end. Leave both empty for none.
reminders.quietPair: Set both times, or leave both empty.
reminders.offline: You are offline. These are the last saved settings; you can change them when you are back online.
reminders.notLoaded: Connect once to load your reminder settings.
reminders.upcomingEmptyBody: Departures, check-outs and due tasks show up here a day and a half ahead.

install.label: Install
install.unavailable: Your browser will offer to install it from its menu.
install.iosStep1: Tap the Share button in Safari.
install.iosStep3: Tap Add. The app opens full screen and keeps its data offline.
